Relying on bravado and short-term debt buybacks rather than addressing underlying debt structural deficits.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing rhetorical dominance (WHO) with macroeconomic market mechanics (HOW), creating a false sense of control.

Bessent runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver, projecting sovereign authority to manufacture confidence while concealing underlying debt and yield pressures.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Rhetorical posturing replaces effective equilibrium restoration.

The Unavoidable Truth: Blustery currency interventions cannot permanently override macroeconomic capital outflows.

The Unavoidable Lie: Government officials can single-handedly outmuscle global bond markets through sheer bravado.
